ابتهلوا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَهَلُوا (ibtahalū) /ib.ta.ha.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِبْتَهَلَ (ibtahala)
# اِبْتَهِلُوا (ibtahilū) /ib.ta.hi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِبْتَهَلَ (ibtahala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
